user.title: Set up ORVIBO MixPad S
user.description: Local control supports type-1 on/off relays only. Cloud access is optional: enabling it sends your account login to the selected ORVIBO server and periodically reads account-wide inventory and states. USA is verified; China is upstream-documented only. Discovery finds addresses for known gateway UIDs; it cannot enumerate child devices. For local-only setup, supply manual topology JSON (see README). Manual gateway IPs are explicitly trusted, including firmware that returns a blank login UID.

init.title: ORVIBO MixPad S options
init.description: Cloud refresh is account-wide with jitter and backoff (minimum 15 minutes). Disable cloud to stop future cloud requests. Cached inventory remains usable locally. Manual gateway addresses override discovery; relays need deviceType 1 and actual endpoints. Discovered devices are added automatically; inventory completeness remains unverified.
